title: 第 15 章
slug: 暴君的炮灰男后穿书全本免费-暴君的炮灰男后穿书最新章节列表
content_zh:
开启二级的条件是150洗白点，还有完成“打通任督二脉”的揍胖崽任务。
薛遥想过很多挣洗白点的方法，其中最容易大量进账的办法有一个——说服皇帝放弃俢蜀道、建行宫。
这个剧情他记忆很深刻。
自古以来都有蜀道难的说法，原著中也有这样的问题，但大齐皇帝久闻巴蜀风光宜人，一直打算巡游蜀地，并建造行宫。
当然，这跟现代意义上的想去四川旅游、买房不一样，皇帝也有深一层心思。
《汉书》中就有提到，巴蜀广汉等地区有“土地肥沃、江水沃野、果实丰饶”等优势，险固的盆地地形也给了这个地区易守难攻的天然优势。
大齐的皇帝心思自然不是想旅游这么简单，而是他的一个兄弟平逸王，这位王爷的封地就是蜀地。
朝野流言四起，说这块封地富得流油，蜀地赋税却不及江南，平逸王的私产要赶超国库了。
这自然是帝王最不想看到的事，大齐皇帝一冲动，就借巡游之名，修蜀地，造行宫，意图告诉自己的弟弟“小心着点儿，老子大手一挥就能扫平你”。
问题是蜀道是真的难，俢蜀道建行宫所需的物力财力，富得流油的大齐出得起，人力就比较困难，建材的运送难度太严峻，导致了大批被征俢蜀道的男丁丧命。
原著中，不堪其苦的服役百姓出现了起义的苗头。
大皇子血书恳求父皇暂时停工，休养生息，才让皇帝暂时收了手。
当然，皇帝的命令没有收回的道理，俢蜀道建行宫的工程只是暂停，指不定哪天要重启，以至于人心惶惶、民怨沸腾。
那么这个锅最后由谁来背的呢？
皇帝肯定不背，大多数情况，让红颜祸水来背，于是这口锅就落到了七皇子他娘的头上。
汐妃背锅的原因很简单：皇帝修行宫的最初理由，是想带着汐妃去自己的神州大地，来一场说走就走的旅行。
去江南旅游已经不能满足皇室的逼格了，哪里难走走哪里，让外国进贡来的美人去看看巴蜀风光，非常有面子。
倒了八辈子霉的汐妃因为这件事，成了众矢之的，这也是七皇子六岁之后的人生惨不忍睹的起因之一。
皇帝拿美人背锅，臣子心里明白是怎么一回事，但是不敢骂皇帝。
老百姓不明白是怎么一回事，但偏好帝王因美色误国的八卦。

所以大家都骂汐妃，汐妃的崽自然也好过不到哪里去。
原著中，这件事引伸出的种种责难与欺辱，是逼得男主黑化的主要原因。
薛遥想想都快崩溃了，三岁的小陆潜，其实是个很阳光的胖崽，爱吃爱睡爱玩具，开心的时候还主动给捏包子脸，完全没有原著中后期那种邪厉乖张的气质。
看书的时候，主角成年后，笑里藏刀、扮猪吃老虎奥斯卡影帝、高智商打脸之类的情节，薛遥觉得帅。
可如今身处其中，薛遥想到这个小胖崽要被一步一步逼成后期那种狠毒可怕的人，心里只有不忍。
何况这只小胖崽先天思维异常，本来就容易麻木冷酷，这么一催化，薛遥是别想治疗矫正了。
所以最好的情况就是掐灭这件事的苗头。
修蜀道的事最终不了了之，却造成了数万百姓的劳苦伤亡。
如果薛遥能一开始就打消皇帝的念头，不仅能让七皇子的成长之路平坦许多，也能间接避免数万百姓的灾难。
这么一来，或许会有数万洗白点的进账。
数万洗白点！
有了这笔洗白点，足够开启所有初级商城！
精神空间的魔方，不止提供食品商城。
魔方底层一共九个方格，分别对应着食材、布料、药材、农作物种子、木材、钢材、书籍等资源。
九种资源分别有二层魔方和三层魔方。
和食品商城一样，二级可以改变刷新次数，终极可以任意搜索资源。
有了这样的储备，薛遥就算不在宫里混，兑换出来的名贵药材和布料，也可以卖给民间商贾。
这样就算宫里混不下去，他也可以去江南买一栋宅子，做点小生意，避免未来被小胖崽切耳朵戳屁屁的厄运。
简直想想就美滋滋！
然而现实是残酷的，他的洗白点余额只剩下36点，平时哪怕馋疯了，也连块蛋糕都舍不得兑换。

贫穷使薛遥充满野心。
很想抓住这次机会，但实行起来太难。

content_en:
The conditions for unlocking the second level are 150 whitewash points and the completion of the "beating up the fat boy" task of "opening up the two channels of Ren and Du".
Xue Yao thought of many ways to earn money, and one of the easiest ways to make a large amount of money was to persuade the emperor to give up the Shu Road and build a palace.
He remembers this plot very well.
Since ancient times, there has been a saying that the road to Shu is difficult, and this problem is also found in the original work. However, the Emperor of Daqi had long heard about the pleasant scenery of Bashu and had always planned to tour Shu and build a palace.
Of course, this is different from wanting to travel to Sichuan or buy a house in the modern sense. The emperor also had deeper thoughts.
"Han Shu" mentioned that areas such as Bashu, Shu, Guanghan, etc. have the advantages of "fertile land, fertile rivers, and abundant fruits." The rugged basin terrain also gives this area a natural advantage that is easy to defend but difficult to attack.
Naturally, the emperor of Da Qi did not just want to travel, but one of his brothers, King Pingyi, whose fiefdom was Shu.
Rumors spread among the government and the public that this fiefdom was extremely rich, but the tax revenue of Shu was not as high as that of Jiangnan, and King Pingyi's private property was about to surpass the national treasury.
This was naturally the last thing the emperor wanted to see. On impulse, the Emperor of Da Qi used the excuse of touring to repair the land of Shu and build a palace, intending to tell his younger brother, "Be careful, I can wipe you out with a wave of my hand."
The problem is that the road to Shu is really difficult. The wealthy Daqi could not afford the material and financial resources needed to build the palace, but the manpower was more difficult. The transportation of building materials was too difficult, which led to the death of a large number of men who were conquered on the road to Shu.
In the original work, the miserable serving people showed signs of uprising.
The eldest prince's blood letter begged his father to temporarily stop work and recuperate, which made the emperor temporarily stop.
Of course, there was no reason to retract the emperor's order, and the construction of the Shu Daoxing Palace was only suspended and might be restarted one day, causing panic and resentment among the people.
So who will bear the blame in the end?
The emperor would definitely not take the blame, and in most cases, it would be the beauty and the misfortune that would take the blame, so the blame fell on the seventh prince's mother's head.
The reason why Concubine Xi takes the blame is very simple: the original reason for the emperor's training palace was to take Concubine Xi to his land of China for a casual trip.
Traveling to the south of the Yangtze River can no longer satisfy the royal family's ambitions. It is very honorable to let beauties from foreign countries pay tribute to see the scenery of Bashu wherever it is difficult to travel.
Concubine Xi, who had been unlucky for eight lifetimes, became the target of public criticism because of this incident. This was also one of the reasons why the seventh prince's life after he turned six was so miserable.
The emperor took the blame for the beauty, and the ministers understood what was going on, but they did not dare to scold the emperor.
The common people didn't understand what was going on, but they preferred the gossip that the emperor ruined the country because of his beauty.
So everyone scolded Concubine Xi, and Concubine Xi's cub was naturally no better off.
In the original work, the various accusations and insults caused by this incident were the main reasons that forced the male protagonist to become a black man.
Xue Yao almost collapsed just thinking about it. The three-year-old Lu Qian was actually a very sunny and fat boy who loved to eat, sleep and toys. He would even take the initiative to make a face when he was happy. He did not have the evil and perverse temperament in the middle and later stages of the original work.
When reading the book, Xue Yao found the story of the protagonist hiding a knife in his smile, pretending to be a pig to eat a tiger and winning an Oscar, and being slapped in the face by his high IQ as an adult, very cool.
But now that he was in it, Xue Yao couldn't bear the thought that this little fat boy would be forced step by step to become the vicious and terrifying person he would become in the later period.
What's more, this little chubby kid was born with abnormal thinking and was easily insensitive and callous. With such a catalyst, Xue Yao couldn't even think about treatment and correction.
So the best thing that can happen is to nip this thing in the first place.
The matter of repairing the Shu Road was eventually abandoned, but it caused tens of thousands of people's casualties due to labor.
If Xue Yao could dispel the emperor's idea from the beginning, it would not only make the growth path of the seventh prince much smoother, but also indirectly avoid the disaster of tens of thousands of people.
In this way, tens of thousands of people may be clearedPoints are paid.
Tens of thousands to clean up!
With this whitewashing point, it is enough to open all primary malls!
The Rubik's Cube in the spiritual space provides more than just a food mall.
There are nine squares on the bottom of the Rubik's Cube, which correspond to resources such as ingredients, cloth, medicinal materials, crop seeds, wood, steel, books, etc.
The nine resources include two-layer Rubik's Cube and three-layer Rubik's Cube respectively.
Like the food mall, the refresh times can be changed at the second level, and resources can be searched at will in the final level.
With such a reserve, even if Xue Yao does not hang out in the palace, the precious medicinal materials and fabrics exchanged can be sold to private merchants.
In this way, even if he can't survive in the palace, he can buy a house in Jiangnan and start a small business to avoid the bad luck of having his ears cut off and his butt poked by a fat kid in the future.
Just thinking about it makes me happy!
However, the reality is cruel. His balance of whitewash points is only 36 points. Even if he is greedy, he would not even exchange for a piece of cake.
Poverty makes Xue Yao full of ambition.
I really want to seize this opportunity, but it is too difficult to implement.
